verdict.rationale: Vendor docs clearly claim the core capability (querying/editing large codebases, debugging via natural language, multi-file automation) and one HN user praises its ability to navigate large codebases with a 1M context window, but multiple hands-on community reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing basic edit/read operations, rewriting files empty, ignoring context files, and even causing data-destructive failures—directly contradicting reliable multi-file implementation.
